paper.title_en: Logarithmic corrections to black hole entropy from minimum-assumptions discretization
paper.abstract_en: We introduce here a general model, under agnostic and minimum assumptions, to uniquely find the entropy area law with a corresponding fixed logarithmic correction term. In this approach, the horizon is discretized into generic Planck-scale cells representing coarse-grained indistinguishable geometric structures, and it is just the statistical combinatorial counting that determines the form of the entropy terms. We highlight the role of the assumptions and their comparison with known models providing fixed logarithmic contributions to the entropy.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出了一种基于最小假设离散化导出黑洞熵面积定律及固定对数修正项的通用模型，属于黑洞热力学领域，理论深度较高，方法新颖，适合推荐阅读。
decision.title_zh: 基于最小假设离散化的黑洞熵对数修正
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在此引入一个一般模型，在不可知且最小假设下，唯一地确定熵面积定律以及相应的固定对数修正项。在这种方法中，视界被离散化为构成粗粒化、不可区分的几何结构的普朗克尺度单元，正是统计组合计数决定了熵项的形式。我们强调了这些假设的作用，并将其与已知的提供固定对数熵贡献的模型进行比较。
